title: Tip from Angela - Nothing Easy is Worth Doing!
summary: A short motivational check-in at the end of the Intermediate CSS module. The message is that programming ability comes from sustained practice rather than innate talent.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Feeling 'not cut out' for coding is common; programming skill is built through repeated practice, not inherited.
Skills that look effortless in others usually hide a large amount of unseen work, and apparent overnight successes tend to follow many earlier attempts.
Progress comes from showing up regularly and putting in hours; results earned this way feel more valuable.
Practical takeaway: keep going through the exercises and projects even when CSS positioning feels frustrating.
